label: Torque and drag spike
engineering_rationale: Torque is a hole-geometry problem first and a rock problem second: dogleg severity, hole size and build section drive drag, so the hole-section signal is judged as strong as the formation itself. Formation match and depth stay because the hole's build rate changes with the section being drilled. Event history is last - a torque spike is usually a downhole-mechanics event with little cross-well signature.
references: Saaty, T.L. (1980). The Analytic Hierarchy Process. McGraw-Hill, New York.
